prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a high-fidelity desktop web app UI mockup, 1536 by 1024, front-on full viewport, no hardware or exterior margin. Product Outdoor OS unifies trails, maps, trip planning, gear packing and GPS recording. Direction B: Map-led workspace. A real application composition, no marketing hero.
STRUCTURE: white 76px horizontal header, small evergreen mountain mark Outdoor OS left, centered Overview, Explore (active), My trips, Gear; green 'Record activity' button and profile icon right. Beneath, a white utility toolbar with page heading 'Find your next way out.' left and a wide outlined search input 'Search a trail or place'; small filter chips 'All trails', 'Day hikes', 'Backpacking'. The remainder is three regions: a 285px white left route-list rail, dominant center terrain map 740px wide, and 330px white right trip panel. Map extends to bottom of viewport, muted desaturated olive and sage terrain with natural shaded ridges and fine contour lines, a single bold dark-green winding highlighted trail, circular start marker; topographic map is clearly labeled 'Illustrative route map' in its lower left, small plus/minus/layers controls at lower right. No inaccurate real-world labels on fictional geometry. Left list heading 'Routes to explore' with three compact polished route entries: 'Teton Crest Trail', 'Wyoming, USA', '40 mi · Hard' (selected soft sage); 'The Enchantments Thru-Hike', 'Washington, USA', '18 mi · Hard'; 'Lost Coast Trail', 'California, USA', '25 mi · Moderate'. Route entries use small landscape thumbnails and are separated by fine rules. Right panel top small 'Example trip · Preview', heading 'Teton Crest Trail', location 'Wyoming, USA', a simple task stepper 'Trail → Pack → Go', values '40 mi' '4 days', heading 'Your pack', checklist 'Shelter' checked, 'Sleep system' checked, 'Water filter' checked, 'Food' unchecked, 'Layers' unchecked, 'First aid' unchecked. Subtle progress '3 of 6 items packed'. Green full-width 'Continue planning' button near bottom, secondary 'View gear locker' text link.
STYLE: mineral-white ground #f6f7f4, white rails, crisp sans typography, dark grey-green #263430 text, evergreen #204d47 active controls, restrained 10-12px radii. High readability, exact alignments, visually calm map, no neon, glass, glow, serif typography, unnecessary charts, invented ratings or weather. This is a beautiful achievable professional map-first outdoor app. Polished real text throughout.
